title: 奉天七六九 下奉天七六九 中
content_zh:
头等车厢，都是可以旋转的真皮座椅，地下铺有地毯，化妆室、卫生间等一应俱全。
不过整个车厢内并没有几个人。
从哈萨克首都到河东市全程二百多公里，头等舱车票为十个银元。
也就是，哪怕哈萨克教师阶层，也要一个月薪金才坐的起。
二等车厢，票价五个银元，三等车厢，票价两银元五百文（两银元五角）。
其实便是三等车厢，对哈萨克平民来说，也差不多是一个月的收入了。
但现今来说，出远门本来就是花大钱的事情，有了火车，比以前坐大马车住大车店要好多天路程花费，可能还略为节省了，加之又节省时间，是以，三等车厢，人挤的满满的。
当然，人多是去边境城市伦河市，而没有资格过境进入大齐河东省。
伦河市因为毗邻大齐，通商口岸，现今是哈萨克第一大城市，比首都要繁华的多。
当然，大齐来说，汴京也已经仅仅担负行政中心的功能，经济最发达的城市则是三百年前开埠的上海市，其次便是商京市、北京市、西安市等。
……
陆宁等一行人进入头等车厢，立时吸引了本来车厢内乘客的注意力，原本车厢内，也就两三名乘客，陆宁不由微微蹙眉，彩珠在旁小声道：“淑妃娘娘和她的同伴都去了餐车。”又说：“汪介海一行，律师和随员共二十多人，汪介海给买了头等车厢票的只有四人，有汪介海，淑妃娘娘，还有两名律师，一是汪介海的副手，同样是资深大状，叫刘达夫，还有一名，也是汪介海的学生，去年刚刚南京法学院毕业，淑妃娘娘的学长，叫陈庆阳，是司法部立法二局副局长陈鼎的长孙。”
陆宁微微颔首，“去餐厅。”
餐厅紧邻头等车厢，也仅仅对头等车厢和二等车厢开放，其内甚至有两个包房。
童珊珊走在最前，等陆宁等进入餐厅时，餐厅一名服务员已经在童珊珊指引下迎上来，甜笑打招呼。
在哈萨克境内，齐人本就是头等人，更莫说坐头等车厢的齐人了。
对于加挂车厢，陆宁等又来自加挂车厢之类的信息，这小小服务员自然不甚清楚。
两个包房都不大，三四人坐的那种，陆宁等一共十人便坐了吧台前几桌，十个人是陆宁、庄妃、顺妃、彩珠、李圆美、童珊珊已经四名便装特勤女卫，当然，四名特勤女卫都拎着小皮箱，里面便是微冲和弹药了，她们看起来上身都有些臃肿，其实是穿了防弹衣，有着随时为祖皇帝挡子弹的觉悟。
“佛跳墙？”陆宁看着服务员送上的菜单微微一怔，这道大齐名菜排在第一位，价格也最高，单人每例一个银元，但想也知道是后世快餐性质那种，而且，单人份竟然要一个银元，相对其价值来说，价格高的吓人。
彩珠已经道：“佛跳墙来两份……”指了指李圆美和童珊珊。

祖皇帝和两位娘娘就不说了，便是她手下的这些特勤女卫，每日吃喝，都是常人难以想象，自不会吃这种明显粗制滥造的菜肴，不过帮忙的两位哈萨克朋友，自要招呼好，好吃不好吃另说，这也是显得对她们的重视。
“啊，不用不用。”童珊珊吓一跳，哪怕她是这列车轮值的头等车厢乘务员，可这种大齐昂贵菜肴，还是离她很远。
李圆美倒是很坦然，微微点头：“谢谢！”毕竟爷爷是上将，家庭非同一般。
陆宁却目光看向包房，两间包房，只有一间传来高谈阔论的声音，不用问，也是自己小淑妃几人在里面了。
“老祖，妾去喊她出来。”小五儿抿嘴一笑。
陆宁点头，便离开大队，到了靠窗一桌，童珊珊端来一杯咖啡。
其实不管是两位妃子还是彩珠等随员，自然知道祖皇帝不会碰这里的吃喝，不然也轮不到童珊珊来服务。
不过不管怎么说，陆宁还是点头对童珊珊笑笑，“谢谢！”
那边，却见小五儿来到包厢外，小声说：“周薇，周薇在吗？”
很快包厢帘一挑，随着里面走出的苗条身影，陆宁心也为之一跳。
走出来的少女眉目如画，清纯披肩长发，更显清丽可人，穿着深灰色法学院学生制服套裙，雪白过膝棉袜黑色小皮鞋，端庄优雅中又显清纯可爱。
看着少女容颜，陆宁眼睛就有些湿，可不是么，这是那小家伙的现代少女版。
却见周薇顺着小五儿手指方向，向自己看过来，俏脸有些疑惑。
但在小五儿劝说下，犹豫了会儿，终于还是走过来。
小五儿在她身后，对陆宁吐吐舌头，意思任务完成，剩下可看老祖宗您的了，她则去了莺莺燕燕那两桌。
“对不起，您认错人了吧？报纸上的照片，做不得真的。”周薇来到陆宁桌前，疑惑的看着陆宁。
江南口音，又糯又软，和那小家伙，也是那么相似。
数百年后的重逢，虽然陆宁知道，这都是自己的臆想，可还是心中微微激荡，鼻子更有些莫名的酸。
“啊，我和您的朋友，真的很像吗？”周薇本来想转身走的，可看陆宁模样，突然有些不忍。
童珊珊又端来了一杯咖啡。

想了想，周薇也就在陆宁对面坐下，问：“听您的朋友说，她也是南京人？有以前的住址吗？我也许可以托朋友帮您找找她。”
“算了……”陆宁摆摆手，不知道为什么，看她少不更事纯纯的样子，突然就觉得有些意兴阑珊，自己又何必打扰她的生活？她终究，并不是自己认识的人。
哦？陆宁抬头，向周薇后方看去。
content_en:
The first-class carriages all have leather seats that can rotate, and there are carpets on the ground floor, as well as dressing rooms and bathrooms.
However, there were not many people in the entire carriage.
The journey from the capital of Kazakhstan to Hedong City is more than 200 kilometers, and the first-class ticket costs ten silver dollars.
In other words, even the Kazakh teaching class needs a month's salary to be able to afford their job.
The fare for a second-class carriage is five silver dollars, and the fare for a third-class carriage is two silver dollars and five hundred wen (two silver dollars and fifty cents).
In fact, even a third-class carriage is almost a month’s income for Kazakh civilians.
But nowadays, traveling far away is always expensive. With the train, it takes many days to travel to a big carriage shop than before. It may save a little money. In addition, it saves time. Therefore, the third-class carriage is full of people.
Of course, most people go to the border city of Lunhe and are not eligible to cross the border into Daqi and Hedong Province.
Because it is adjacent to Daqi and a trading port, Lunhe City is now the largest city in Kazakhstan and is much more prosperous than the capital.
Of course, for Daqi, Bianjing has only served as the administrative center. The most economically developed city is Shanghai, which opened as a port three hundred years ago, followed by Shangjing City, Beijing City, Xi'an City, etc.
…
Lu Ning and other people entered the first-class carriage, which immediately attracted the attention of the passengers in the carriage. Originally, there were only two or three passengers in the carriage. Lu Ning could not help but frown slightly. Caizhu whispered beside her: "Concubine Shu and her companions all went to the dining car." He also said: "Wang Jiehai and his party, including lawyers and attachés, totaled more than 20 people. Wang Jiehai bought a head. There were only four people waiting for tickets, including Wang Jiehai, Empress Shu, and two lawyers. One was Wang Jiehai’s deputy, also a senior magistrate, named Liu Dafu, and the other was Wang Jiehai’s student, who just graduated from Nanjing Law School last year. Empress Shu’s senior is Chen Qingyang, the eldest grandson of Chen Ding, deputy director of the Second Legislative Bureau of the Ministry of Justice. "
Lu Ning nodded slightly, "Go to the restaurant."
The restaurant is next to the first-class carriage and is only open to first-class and second-class carriages. There are even two private rooms in it.
Tong Shanshan walked in the front. When Lu Ning and others entered the restaurant, a waiter from the restaurant had already come up to her under the guidance of Tong Shanshan and greeted her with a sweet smile.
In Kazakhstan, Qi people are considered first-class people, let alone Qi people who ride in first-class carriages.
Regarding the information about the additional carriages, Lu Ning and others came from the additional carriages, so the little waiter naturally didn't know much about it.
The two private rooms were not big, and could only seat three or four people. A total of ten people including Lu Ning and others sat at the tables in front of the bar. The ten people were Lu Ning, Zhuang Concubine, Shun Concubine, Caizhu, Li Yuanmei, and Tong Shanshan, as well as four plain-clothes special service female guards. Of course, the four special service female guards all carried small suitcases with micro-chargers and ammunition in them. They all looked a little bloated in the upper body, but in fact they were wearing bulletproof vests, and they had the consciousness of taking bullets for the ancestor emperor at any time.
"Buddha jumped over the wall?" Lu Ning was slightly startled when he looked at the menu brought by the waiter. This famous dish was ranked first, and the price was also the highest. It cost one silver dollar per person, but he thought it was the type of fast food in later generations, and it cost one silver dollar for a single person. Compared to its value, the price was shockingly high.
Caizhu had already said: "Buddha jumps over the wall for two..." and pointed at Li Yuanmei and Tong Shanshan.
Not to mention the Emperor Zu and the two empresses, these special female guards under her eat and drink every day in a way that is unimaginable to ordinary people. They will not eat such obviously crude dishes. However, the two Kazakh friends who are helping must greet them well, whether they are delicious or not. This also shows that they attach great importance to them.
"Ah, no, no, no." Tong Shanshan was startled. Even though she was a first-class conductor on duty on this train, such expensive Daqi dishes were still far away from her.
Li Yuanmei was very calm and nodded slightly: "Thank you!" After all, her grandfather was a general and her family was extraordinary.Lu Ning looked at the private rooms. Only one of the two private rooms could be heard talking loudly. Needless to say, his concubines and concubines were also in there.
"Ancestor, I'm going to call her out." Xiao Wu'er pursed his lips and smiled.
Lu Ning nodded and left the team. When he arrived at a table by the window, Tong Shanshan brought a cup of coffee.
In fact, whether it is the two concubines or Caizhu and other attendants, they naturally know that Emperor Zu will not touch the food and drink here, otherwise it will not be Tong Shanshan's turn to serve.
But no matter what, Lu Ning still nodded and smiled at Tong Shanshan, "Thank you!"
Over there, Xiao Wuer came outside the box and whispered: "Zhou Wei, is Zhou Wei here?"
Soon the curtain of the box was raised, and Lu Ning's heart skipped a beat as the slender figure walked out.
The girl who walked out had picturesque features, pure and shawl-length hair, which made her even more beautiful and lovely. She was wearing a dark gray law school student uniform skirt, snow-white knee-high cotton socks and black leather shoes. She was dignified and elegant yet pure and cute.
Looking at the girl's face, Lu Ning's eyes were a little wet, wasn't it? This was the modern girl version of that little guy.
But he saw Zhou Wei following the direction of Xiao Wu'er's finger and looking towards him, with a look of confusion on her pretty face.
But after Xiao Wuer's persuasion, he hesitated for a while and finally came over.
Xiao Wuer was behind her, sticking out her tongue at Lu Ning, meaning that the task was completed and the rest was up to you, ancestor, so she went to the two tables of Yingying Yanyan.
"I'm sorry, did you recognize the wrong person? The photos in the newspaper cannot be authentic." Zhou Wei came to Lu Ning's table and looked at Lu Ning doubtfully.
The Jiangnan accent is waxy and soft, so similar to that little guy's.
After meeting again hundreds of years later, although Lu Ning knew that this was all his imagination, he still felt a little agitated in his heart and his nose felt inexplicably sore.
"Ah, are your friends and I really alike?" Zhou Wei originally wanted to turn around and leave, but looking at Lu Ning's appearance, she suddenly couldn't bear it.
Tong Shanshan brought another cup of coffee.
After thinking about it, Zhou Wei sat down opposite Lu Ning and asked, "I heard from your friend that she is also from Nanjing? Do you have a previous address? Maybe I can ask a friend to help you find her."
"Forget it..." Lu Ning waved his hands. He didn't know why, but seeing how innocent she was, he suddenly felt a little uninterested. Why did he bother her life? After all, she is not someone she knows.
oh? Lu Ning raised his head and looked behind Zhou Wei.
